name: Get Bit
summary: Players race swimmers to escape a shark by playing numbered cards; last in line loses limbs until eliminated.
rules_text: Each player has a colored swimmer with 4 limbs and a hand of cards numbered 1-7 (remove 7s for 5 players, 6s and 7s for 4 players). Swimmers start in a line with a Shark at the rear. Each round: all players choose a card from hand face-down and reveal simultaneously. Any player whose number is duplicated by another is tied and does not move. Untied players move their swimmer to the front of the line in ascending card order (lowest first). Then the swimmer at the back of the line loses one limb. If it has no limbs left it is eliminated; otherwise it moves to the front of the line and its owner reclaims all played cards. Any player with fewer than two cards left also reclaims their discard. Skip the bite on first round. Last two swimmers remain: front swimmer wins.
